Use the filename or a clear alias as the label, adding only enough parent directories to distinguish files; keep full paths out of labels. Default to the name alone; when precise locations matter, append :24 or :24–30, with no # or L in the line suffix.

tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding. An answer item with empty selected and no custom means the user skipped that question: continue without it, do not ask it again, and do not treat the skip as permission.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "npm install" → "Install package dependencies".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

New sessions use this session's working directory and preset. With this_session or new_once, a delivery waits until the previous one finishes, and only the latest occurrence that passed meanwhile is delivered. Use this_session for reminders and for follow-ups to this conversation; use new_once or new for independent work, such as a recurring report, and whenever the user asks for a new conversation.

The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its name. If you are still online when it finishes, the runtime automatically delivers its completion notice. The notice includes the final answer unless the child sent you a message just before finishing. tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

1: """Embedding 提供方：确定性假向量与 OpenAI 兼容接口。
2: 
3: 知识库只依赖这里的 :class:`EmbeddingProvider` 协议：
4: 
5: - :class:`FakeEmbeddingProvider`：零依赖、确定性的词袋向量，供测试与无密钥开发环境使用；
6: - :class:`OpenAIEmbeddingProvider`：按批 POST ``{base_url}/embeddings``，失败统一抛
7:   :class:`EmbeddingUnavailableError`。
8: 
9: 选择逻辑见 :func:`get_embedding_provider`。fake 模式只保证排序有意义，
10: 绝对分数不可解释（短 query 对长 chunk 的余弦存在上界），检索层需要把阈值降为 0，
11: 详见设计文档 §8.2。
12: """
13: 
14: from __future__ import annotations
15: 
16: import hashlib
17: import logging
18: import math
19: import re
20: from typing import Protocol
21: 
22: import httpx
23: 
24: from app.core.config import Settings, get_settings
25: 
26: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
27: 
28: # 中文按字符 bigram 切分；标点/空白不会命中该正则，天然作为分隔符。
29: _CJK_RUN = re.compile(r"[\u3400-\u4dbf\u4e00-\u9fff]+")
30: # 英文/数字按词切分（匹配前整体小写）。
31: _LATIN_RUN = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9]+")
32: 
33: 
34: class EmbeddingUnavailableError(Exception):
35:     """Embedding 服务不可用或响应结构异常；上层据此返回 503 或记为失败。"""
36: 
37: 
38: class EmbeddingProvider(Protocol):
39:     """Embedding 提供方协议：批量文本进、同序向量出。"""
40: 
41:     async def embed(self, texts: list[str]) -> list[list[float]]:
42:         """把一批文本转成等长、同序的向量列表。"""
43:         ...
44: 
45: 
46: def _tokenize(text: str) -> list[str]:
47:     """切分 token：中文 bigram，英文/数字小写词，标点与空白不计。"""
48:     tokens: list[str] = []
49:     for run in _CJK_RUN.findall(text):
50:         if len(run) == 1:
51:             # 单字无法组成 bigram，保留单字，避免短查询退化成全零向量。
52:             tokens.append(run)
53:         else:
54:             tokens.extend(run[index : index + 2] for index in range(len(run) - 1))
55:     tokens.extend(_LATIN_RUN.findall(text.lower()))
56:     return tokens
57: 
58: 
59: def _hashed_token(token: str, dim: int) -> tuple[int, float]:
60:     """token → (维度下标, ±1)：带符号哈希用于抵消碰撞偏置。"""
61:     digest = hashlib.blake2b(token.encode("utf-8"), digest_size=8).digest()
62:     index = int.from_bytes(digest, "big") % dim
63:     sign = 1.0 if digest[0] % 2 == 0 else -1.0
64:     return index, sign
65: 
66: 
67: class FakeEmbeddingProvider:
68:     """确定性的词袋假向量：相同文本永远得到相同向量，且已 L2 归一化。
69: 
70:     算法（设计文档 §8.2）：中文 bigram + 英文小写词 → ``blake2b`` 带符号哈希到
71:     ``dim`` 维 → 词频累加 → L2 归一化。空输入返回全零向量，不做除零。
72: 
73:     该模型下短 query 对长 chunk 的余弦存在上界，绝对分数不可解释；
74:     检索层需要在 fake 模式把阈值降为 0，只依赖排序。
75:     """
76: 
77:     def __init__(self, dim: int) -> None:
78:         if dim <= 0:
79:             raise ValueError(f"Embedding 维度必须为正数，当前为 {dim}")
80:         self.dim = dim
81: 
82:     async def embed(self, texts: list[str]) -> list[list[float]]:
83:         return [self._embed_one(text) for text in texts]
84: 
85:     def _embed_one(self, text: str) -> list[float]:
86:         # 词频累加；使用普通 dict 保证 token 顺序确定，向量逐位可复现。
87:         counts: dict[str, int] = {}
88:         for token in _tokenize(text):
89:             counts[token] = counts.get(token, 0) + 1
90:         vector = [0.0] * self.dim
91:         for token, count in counts.items():
92:             index, sign = _hashed_token(token, self.dim)
93:             vector[index] += sign * count
94:         norm = math.sqrt(sum(value * value for value in vector))
95:         if norm == 0.0:
96:             # 空文本或纯标点：返回全零向量，避免除零。
97:             return vector
98:         return [value / norm for value in vector]
99: 
100: 
101: class OpenAIEmbeddingProvider:
102:     """OpenAI 兼容 ``/embeddings`` 接口实现；按批发送，不做重试。"""
103: 
104:     def __init__(
105:         self,
106:         api_key: str,
107:         base_url: str,
108:         model: str,
109:         dim: int,
110:         timeout: float,
111:         batch_size: int,
112:         *,
113:         transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None,
114:     ) -> None:
115:         if dim <= 0:
116:             raise ValueError(f"Embedding 维度必须为正数，当前为 {dim}")
117:         if batch_size <= 0:
118:             raise ValueError(f"Embedding batch_size 必须为正数，当前为 {batch_size}")
119:         self._api_key = api_key
120:         self._base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
121:         self._model = model
122:         self._dim = dim
123:         self._timeout = timeout
124:         self._batch_size = batch_size
125:         # 仅测试注入（httpx.MockTransport）；生产走默认传输层。
126:         self._transport = transport
127: 
128:     async def embed(self, texts: list[str]) -> list[list[float]]:
129:         if not texts:
130:             return []
131:         headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
132:         # 兼容 Ollama/vLLM 等无需鉴权的本地服务：只有存在密钥时才带 Authorization。
133:         if self._api_key:
134:             headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {self._api_key}"
135:         vectors: list[list[float]] = []
136:         async with httpx.AsyncClient(
137:             transport=self._transport,
138:             timeout=httpx.Timeout(self._timeout),
139:         ) as client:
140:             for start in range(0, len(texts), self._batch_size):
141:                 batch = texts[start : start + self._batch_size]
142:                 vectors.extend(await self._embed_batch(client, headers, batch))
143:         return vectors
144: 
145:     async def _embed_batch(
146:         self, client: httpx.AsyncClient, headers: dict[str, str], batch: list[str]
147:     ) -> list[list[float]]:
148:         try:
149:             response = await client.post(
150:                 f"{self._base_url}/embeddings",
151:                 json={"model": self._model, "input": batch},
152:                 headers=headers,
153:             )
154:         except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
155:             # 连接失败/超时等传输层错误视为服务不可用，交由上层降级或返回 503。
156:             raise EmbeddingUnavailableError("Embedding 请求失败，无法连接服务") from exc
157:         if not 200 <= response.status_code < 300:
158:             raise EmbeddingUnavailableError(f"Embedding 接口返回 HTTP {response.status_code}")
159:         return self._parse_vectors(response, expected=len(batch))
160: 
161:     def _parse_vectors(self, response: httpx.Response, *, expected: int) -> list[list[float]]:
162:         try:
163:             payload = response.json()
164:         except ValueError as exc:
165:             raise EmbeddingUnavailableError("Embedding 接口返回的不是合法 JSON") from exc
166:         data = payload.get("data") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None
167:         if not isinstance(data, list) or len(data) != expected:
168:             raise EmbeddingUnavailableError("Embedding 接口返回结构异常：data 条数与输入不符")
169:         vectors: list[list[float]] = []
170:         for item in data:
171:             embedding = item.get("embedding") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
172:             if not isinstance(embedding, list) or len(embedding) != self._dim:
173:                 raise EmbeddingUnavailableError(
174:                     f"Embedding 接口返回结构异常：向量维度应为 {self._dim}"
175:                 )
176:             try:
177:                 vectors.append([float(value) for value in embedding])
178:             except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
179:                 raise EmbeddingUnavailableError(
180:                     "Embedding 接口返回结构异常：向量元素非数值"
181:                 ) from exc
182:         return vectors
183: 
184: 
185: _provider: EmbeddingProvider | None = None
186: 
187: 
188: def _build_provider(config: Settings) -> EmbeddingProvider:
189:     """按配置构建提供方；显式 openai 但密钥不可用属于配置错误。"""
190:     if config.embedding_provider == "fake":
191:         logger.info("Embedding 使用 fake 提供方 dim=%s（分数不可解释）", config.embedding_dim)
192:         return FakeEmbeddingProvider(config.embedding_dim)
193:     if config.embedding_provider == "openai" and not config.embedding_key_usable:
194:         # 不静默降级：显式要求真实接口却没密钥，必须让部署方看到配置错误。
195:         raise ValueError(
196:             "EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openai 时必须配置可用的 EMBEDDING_API_KEY（当前为空或占位符）"
197:         )
198:     if not config.embedding_key_usable:
199:         logger.info("Embedding 未配置可用密钥，回退 fake 提供方 dim=%s", config.embedding_dim)
200:         return FakeEmbeddingProvider(config.embedding_dim)
201:     logger.info(
202:         "Embedding 使用 OpenAI 兼容接口 model=%s base_url=%s",
203:         config.embedding_model,
204:         config.embedding_base_url,
205:     )
206:     return OpenAIEmbeddingProvider(
207:         config.embedding_api_key,
208:         config.embedding_base_url,
209:         config.embedding_model,
210:         config.embedding_dim,
211:         config.embedding_timeout_seconds,
212:         config.embedding_batch_size,
213:     )
214: 
215: 
216: def get_embedding_provider(settings: Settings | None = None) -> EmbeddingProvider:
217:     """按配置返回进程级单例；切换配置后需 :func:`reset_embedding_provider`。"""
218:     global _provider
219:     if _provider is None:
220:         _provider = _build_provider(settings or get_settings())
221:     return _provider
222: 
223: 
224: def reset_embedding_provider() -> None:
225:     """测试辅助：清空提供方单例缓存（下次调用按当前配置重建）。"""
226:     global _provider
227:     _provider = None
228: 
229:

231:     "EmbeddingProvider",

233:     "FakeEmbeddingProvider",
